query: What's the maximum execution duration for a single AWS Lambda MicroVM, and can it be raised?
goldAnswer: 8 hours (28,800 seconds) per MicroVM; the quota is not adjustable.

query: cloudflare workers paid plan default subrequests per invocation limit
goldAnswer: 10,000 subrequests per invocation [Workers Paid default; can be raised per Worker up to 10 million with the `limits` setting in the Wrangler config; Workers Free: 50]

query: What's the longest a Vercel Function can run on the Pro plan with fluid compute, including beta options?
goldAnswer: 1800 seconds (30 minutes) [the extended maximum, in beta for supported Node.js, Bun and Python runtimes; the generally available maximum is 800 seconds and the default is 300 seconds]

query: gcloud run jobs --task-timeout maximum for GPU tasks
goldAnswer: 1 hour [for tasks using GPUs; other tasks can be set up to 168 hours (7 days), and the default is 10 minutes]

query: supabase edge functions max secret size
goldAnswer: 48 KiB (24,576 characters) per secret [a project can have up to 100 secrets]

query: neon free plan compute hours per project per month
goldAnswer: 100 CU-hours per project per month, enough to run a 0.25 CU compute for 400 hours.

query: sanity content lake listener connection max lifetime
goldAnswer: 4 hours [connections are dropped between 3 hours 50 minutes and 4 hours]

query: How do I let several runs wait in a GitHub Actions concurrency group on GitHub.com instead of each new run canceling the pending one?
goldAnswer: Set `queue: max` in the `concurrency` block [up to 100 jobs or workflow runs can then wait; the default, `single`, keeps one pending; it can't be combined with `cancel-in-progress: true`]
30 minutes [extra time added on top of `minimumReleaseAge` before an update is treated as stable; set it to `null` to disable the buffer]

query: On Inngest's Free plan, how long can a single function run last, including sleeps?
goldAnswer: 30 days in total, counting time spent in `step.sleep()`, `step.sleepUntil()`, and `step.waitForEvent()`.

query: Which Telegram Bot API version added the sendRichMessage method?
Which version of the Notion JavaScript SDK (@notionhq/client) added support for Notion API version 2026-03-11?
What's the default rate limit for the Resend API, and does it apply per API key?
goldAnswer: 10 requests per second per team, shared across all of the team's API keys rather than per key [trusted senders can ask for an increase]

query: How many requests per hour can I make to Linear's GraphQL API with an API key?
goldAnswer: 2,500 requests per hour per user, shared across all of that user's API keys (OAuth apps get 5,000 per hour).

query: When will npm stop letting granular access tokens publish new package versions directly?
goldAnswer: January 2027 [npm's docs give this as the removal date; GitHub's changelog calls it a target. Migration paths: trusted publishing (OIDC), or a stage-only token with `npm stage publish` and maintainer 2FA approval]

query: From August 31, 2026, what target API level do new Wear OS apps and updates need to be accepted on Google Play?
goldAnswer: Android 15 (API level 35) or higher [the same as Android Automotive OS apps; the general requirement is Android 16 (API level 36)]

query: How many builds can I have pending per platform on EAS Build before new ones get rejected?
goldAnswer: 50 per platform: once more than 50 builds are pending for a platform, new builds are rejected until the pending count drops below the limit.

query: How many domain names can a single Let's Encrypt certificate include if I request the tlsserver profile?
goldAnswer: 25 names under the tlsserver profile (the default classic profile allows 100).

query: What's the hourly read limit for a 1Password service account token on a 1Password Business account?
goldAnswer: 10,000 reads per hour per service account token [writes are limited separately to 1,000 per hour]
